objective: The team's patterns as experiments (package 28.6 of the phase 6 plan): each pattern played on the same written people as its baseline, in the same run, with the same replica seeds, both arms live, and judged by a gate fixed before the run (better on the part the pattern targets, no worse on the others, its extra questions and cost bounded). The second opinion (two readers of the card's family, a judge that asks the person where they differ) against the single agent (the loop with the conversation reader); the debate (two solution designers and a judge) against the single designer. Material: the 15 dev people and the 30 people of the fifth sealed set, spent in 28.7 and read as dev material while the patterns were designed. A pattern's switch in the team's settings turns on only where its newest result here passed.
rule: Dev evidence on written people over seeded replicas: a pass turns a pattern's switch on for measurement in the team, never a sealed verdict (the fresh sixth sealed set of 28.7 judges the team with whatever passed), and nothing about production readiness. A run in which a model request failed is not stored.
